subject: Spanska
title: Reading comprehension: an introduction
sourceSummary: A short text where a person introduces themselves and their family, with questions about details and context.

questions.prompt:
Read the text: "¡Hola! Me llamo Carlos y tengo trece años. Vivo en Barcelona con mi familia. Tengo una hermana; se llama Laura y tiene diez años."

How old is Carlos?
questions.opener: Look for the number right after "tengo ... años".
questions.explanation: "Tengo trece años" means "I am thirteen years old". "Trece" is 13.

questions.prompt: Same text. Where does Carlos live?
questions.explanation: "Vivo en Barcelona" means "I live in Barcelona".

questions.opener: Look for the sentence about "una hermana".
questions.explanation: "Tengo una hermana; se llama Laura" means "I have a sister; her name is Laura".

questions.prompt:
New text: "Los sábados, Carlos juega al fútbol con sus amigos. Después, come pizza en casa de su abuela. Los domingos descansa."

What does Carlos do on Saturdays?
questions.opener: "Juega al fútbol" — the verb jugar means to play.
choices: He plays soccer with his friends
questions.explanation: "Juega al fútbol con sus amigos" means "he plays soccer with his friends".

questions.prompt: Same text. Where does he eat pizza?
questions.opener: "En casa de su abuela" — who lives there?
questions.explanation: "En casa de su abuela" means "at his grandmother's home".

questions.prompt: Same text. What does Carlos do on Sundays, according to the last sentence? Answer in English with one word.
questions.opener: The verb descansar means to rest.

questions.prompt: Read the text again and write a Spanish sentence (3–5 words) that answers: "¿Con quién juega Carlos al fútbol?" (Who does Carlos play soccer with?)
questions.opener: The answer is in the first sentence about Saturdays.
steps: Find the right part of the text: "Carlos juega al fútbol con sus amigos."
Pick out the answer to "with whom": "con sus amigos" (with his friends).
Build a short sentence: "Juega con sus amigos." (He plays with his friends.)

questions.prompt: Which strategies help you understand a simple Spanish text at the grade 7 level?
questions.opener: You don't need to understand every word to understand the big picture.
questions.answer: Look for familiar patterns: "me llamo" (introduction), "tengo ... años" (age), "vivo en" (where you live), "los sábados/domingos" (weekdays + activities). Guess unknown words from context instead of looking up every word. Read the text once for the overall gist and once more for the details. Look for present-tense verbs (juega, come, vive, descansa) to understand what's happening, and possessive words (su, sus, mi) to understand who is doing what.

questions.prompt:
Read the text: "Ana tiene un perro que se llama Rex. Los lunes, va al parque con Rex después de la escuela. A Rex le gusta correr y jugar con la pelota."

¿Qué animal tiene Ana?
questions.opener: Read the text about Ana and her dog.
questions.explanation: The text says "Ana tiene un perro que se llama Rex", meaning she has a dog named Rex.

questions.prompt: Same text. ¿Cuándo va Ana al parque con Rex?
questions.opener: Look for the time expression in the second sentence.
choices: Los lunes, después de la escuela
questions.explanation: "Los lunes... después de la escuela" means "on Mondays, after school".

questions.prompt: Same text. ¿Qué le gusta hacer a Rex?
questions.opener: The last sentence describes what Rex likes to do.
choices: Correr y jugar con la pelota
questions.explanation: "A Rex le gusta correr y jugar con la pelota" means "Rex likes to run and play with the ball".

questions.prompt:
New text: "Mi amiga Elena tiene quince años y estudia en un instituto en Valencia. Los fines de semana, trabaja en la tienda de su tío. Le gusta mucho la música y toca la guitarra."

¿Dónde trabaja Elena los fines de semana?
questions.opener: Read the new text about Elena.
choices: En la tienda de su tío
questions.explanation: "Trabaja en la tienda de su tío" means "she works at her uncle's store".

questions.opener: Look for the word for instrument in the last sentence.
questions.explanation: "Toca la guitarra" means "she plays the guitar".

questions.opener: Her age is mentioned in the first sentence.
questions.explanation: "Tiene quince años" means "she is fifteen years old".

questions.opener: The school is mentioned in the first sentence.
questions.explanation: "Estudia en un instituto en Valencia" means "she studies at a high school in Valencia".
